variables.name: title
variables.description: A short, specific title for this report, drawn from what the workspace's sources are actually about.

variables.name: abstract
variables.description: A brief, self-contained summary covering the aims, methods, key results, and conclusion — understandable without reading the rest of the report.

variables.name: introduction
variables.description: Background context, the question or problem addressed, and its significance.

variables.name: methods
variables.description: How the work was conducted, in traceable detail — e.g. the dosing regimen, experimental design, or procedure the sources describe.

variables.name: results
variables.description: Findings, stated objectively — no interpretation here; what they mean belongs in discussion.

variables.name: discussion
variables.description: What the results mean, their limitations, and how they relate back to the introduction's stated question or problem.

variables.name: conclusion
variables.description: A summary of what the results established and its implications, referring back to the introduction's stated purpose. Introduces no claim the results didn't already support.
